en.html:
...The broken-down hut.

Back, apparently. To reality.

Reality.

Yes. This side was reality. Until now, I had been dreaming.

............Had the Buddha of this mountain temple guided me?

The thought came, and I laughed at it immediately.

Arre, what guidance. The road that dream had shown me was nowhere near the Buddhist path.

en.html:
Refreshed? Not remotely.

Peace of mind and I were not even on visiting terms.

My limbs were heavier than before. The weight of my sins, which the dream had made me face again.

But this weight, I did not resent. Mine to carry. I understood that now.

It told me what Kageaki Minato had piled up so that his will could prevail. Sin upon sin.

My will.

There was an aim I had decided to reach, even if I had to take other people's lives to reach it.

Not yet achieved.

I had to achieve it. Once I had stepped onto this road, crushing lives beneath my soles, I had to go right to the end.

Trample other people's lives on your way forward, and where is your turning back?

Unless you can bring those people back to life, nowhere.

気分は、全く爽快ではない。
　晴れやかさとはどこまでも縁遠い。

　むしろ手足は重さを増している。
　それは今の夢が改めて直面させた、俺の罪の重さだ。

　その重さを、しかし――厭わない。
　これは俺の背負うべきものなのだと自覚する。

　この重さが、俺に教える。
　これは湊斗景明が意思を貫徹する為に、重ねてきた
罪なのだと。

　意思。

　他人の命を略奪してでも、果たさねばならぬのだと、
決意した目的があった。
　それはまだ、遂げていない。

　遂げねばならぬ。
　一度、人の命を靴底に潰して行く道程へ踏み出した
以上は、断じて最後までゆかねばならぬ。

　他人の生命を踏みしめてゆく道は、決して引き返せ
ない道。
　殺した者を生き返らせてやれないのなら、決して。

Our roads had already parted.

That much I understood.

My road had no turning back. Ichijou's road also, no turning back.

From now on, she could never accept me as Muramasa. Just as I could no longer accept her as Masamune.

My confusion had twisted the two roads together for a while. That was gone now.

Separate roads.

Ichijou and I would not be going the same way.

Muramasa《Mido.》
Kageaki"The enemy you hate dies, and the friend beside you dies also... If you cannot bear that, you should not kill the enemy to begin with. The necessary resolve is missing."
Kageaki"Put down Muramasa, pick up another weapon, do the killing with that? No. Kill the enemy, lose no ally—such a convenient arrangement. Such cowardice. If you do not want your ally dead, you should not kill the enemy either."
Kageaki"An enemy's death. An ally's death. Equal value. We must not put a difference between them. Cannot... That is only selfishness narrowing our sight. Apna aadmi, paraaya aadmi. My person, somebody else's person. To somebody, both are their own."
Kageaki"The enemy is evil and good both. Look only at his evil, only at his guilt, then kill him. What a fine deception. Kindly cut away the villain, leave the father standing. Leave the friend. Leave every person somebody else sees when looking at him. Such considerate work we expect from a sword. Do the killing, keep its ugliness out of sight. Nothing but baseness."
Kageaki"With this one blade, I cut good and evil together. That is what we must be prepared for. Whoever kills, whoever is killed————"

en.html:
Good and evil, cut down together.

The truth of conflict.

The nature of martial force. No distinctions. Killing only, that is its power.

That was what I had seen through to.

So, Ichijou————

Never again would I believe in the justice of people who fought and killed.

With you, I could not go.

I had decided.

I would betray you.
